notes: The Tibetan Empire collapsed in 842; Tibet was divided.
The Uyghur Khaganate fell in 840; its successors held only Gansu and Turpan.
The Magyars had conquered the Carpathian Basin (895–900).
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
